Class CustodyFeeEngine

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.CustodyFeeEngine
public final class CustodyFeeEngine extends Object
One account's custody calculation. No database access: quotes and booking are supplied by the replay. Estimates never consume credits, and committed fills are identified so retries cannot spend an allowance twice.

    • carryIn

      public void carryIn(List<CustodyFeeEngine.Holding> holdings)
      The positions held when the replay opens. They count as held exchanges of the opening cycle even if they are sold before its first observation. Must be called before any traded(LocalDate, String, Map) of the opening cycle.

    • traded

      public void traded(LocalDate date, String fillId, Map<String,Object> trade)
      Adds the exchange of a booked trade to its billing cycle, so a per-exchange fee is due even for an exchange that holds nothing at the observation. A trade on or before the opening only counts when it lies in the opening cycle.
      Parameters:
      date - the trade day
      fillId - the identity of the fill; a repeated one is ignored
      trade - mic, instrument, assetclass, isin and currency of the traded instrument
